name: Hotel Schalber
beschreibung: Wellness Residenz Schalber is located in Serfaus on the sunny high plateau of the Tyrolean Oberland. As a world-class 5-star superior resort, it features an extraordinary wellness and spa landscape with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, and relaxation lounges designed for both adults and families. In winter, it provides seamless connectivity to the premier Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski paradise, alongside boundless summer hiking trails and acclaimed gourmet gastronomy.
kurzbeschreibung: Wellness Residenz Schalber in Serfaus offers 5-star superior luxury, an extensive spa and pool landscape, award-winning gourmet dining, and direct Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis access.
